test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 10 Jan 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate homophone to fill in the blank.

In many road accidents people break their bones mainly because their vehicle ___________ fails.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 1' **i.e.** 'Brake'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Brake:** This is the** correct homophone** that fits the context of the sentence.
 
• The sentence **talks about** road accidents and how people break their bones.
 
• The word **"brake" **refers to the action of slowing down or stopping a vehicle using the brakes.
 
• In this** context, **it implies that the accidents happen because the vehicle's braking system fails.

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is:* 'In many road accidents people break their bones mainly because their vehicle** brake** fails'.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Broke: **"Broke" is the past tense of the verb "break," which means to separate into parts or damage something. It does not convey the idea of a vehicle's failure causing accidents.
 
• **Brow:** "Brow" refers to the ridge of hair above the eye or the forehead. It has no relation to road accidents or vehicle failure.
 
• **Bleak: **"Bleak" means lacking vegetation, desolate, or grim. It does not convey the idea of vehicle failure causing accidents.
